[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[Image:Lahtenda Bog northeastern ruins.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = Northeastern ruins | pic3 = [[Image:Lahtenda Bog sunspear crypts.jpg|196px]] | pic3-text = Sunspear crypts | ingame name=Lahtenda Bog | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=484 }} The [[Lahtenda Bog]] is a swampy lowland area situated in the southwestern corner of the island of [[Istan]]. It is dotted with old ruins, including old [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspear]] crypts and tombs, that suggest that the area may once have been drier. Now it is a relatively dangerous place populated by large numbers of [[Insect]]s, groups of [[Skale]], [[Popup|hidden]] [[Mandragor]]s, and [[Harpy|Skree harpies]]. [[Corsair]]s are also known to frequently carry out their illegal activities in this area. == Getting there == Can only be accessed via the [[Blacktide Den (outpost)|Blacktide Den outpost]], even without completing the [[Blacktide Den]] [[mission]] beforehand. The [[primary quest]] [[War Preparations (Ghost Reconnaissance)]] will lead [[Nightfall]] [[character]]s to this area. == Shrines == ; [[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: * [[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Corsair Bounty]]1 ** Northwestern area, north of the watery area. ** Towards the southeast where two [[collector]]s are situated. * [[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Insect Hunt]]2 ** The southwestern corner of the northeastern ruins. * [[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Mandragor Hunt]]3 ** Northeast, at the exit into [[Blacktide Den (outpost)|Blacktide Den]]. ** The northeastern corner of the Sunspear crypt. * [[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Skale Hunt]]1 ** Southeast from the Sunspear crypt. ** The northwestern corner of the Sunspear crypt. 1 In [[normal mode]], only for characters with [[Sunspear rank]] below 6.

[[Mandragor]]s * {{n}} 16 (28) [[Najab Lifedrinker]] → ([[The Lifedrinker]]) == Notes == * This is one of the few areas in [[Guild Wars]] where the ambient environment of the area resembles nighttime. * If a character completes the mission [[Blacktide Den]] and never actually enters the area separately, the label will not appear on their map. Keep this in mind when going for the Vanquisher and Cartographer titles. * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.5% to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. *{{Vanquisher|count = 401|low = 356|high = 611}} ** Most, if not all, of the quests that take place here increase the total number of foes. The master difficulty quest [[What do you do with a drunken shauben|What Do You Do with a Drunken Shauben?]] in particular will increase the total number of foes by ''at least'' a hundred. ** [[Habab]] the merchant is available if your bags are starting to get full. ** [[Condition]] removal skills will come in handy here, due to the foes inflicting a variety of conditions, including [[disease]], [[bleeding]], and [[cripple]]. ** There are a lot of [[Popup|hidden]] [[Mandragor]]s throughout this area, especially the northern half. ** Vanquishing this area up to 10 times on an Elonian Support [[Weekly bonuses|weekly bonus]] will allow any character to achieve ''Legendary Spearmarshal''. == Trivia == * The map included in the collector's edition of Nightfall named this area "Lahtendi Bog" instead. It is not known if the name was changed in the last minute or if it was a printing error. {{Explorable areas in Istan}} [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[de:Lahtenda-Sumpf]]
